items.title: Dolly Douroux Adams Interview, 1962-04-18
items.q: Professor Mineta taught me my first lessons... And then when I was 13 is when I started out with Professor Mineta. I started playing in his band.

ctx.x: And what was your name before you were married? Dolly DeRux. DeRux. So you were a daughter of one of Professor Mineta's sisters.
That's right. My mother, which is Professor Mineta's sister, she was also a musician.
Yes, I remember that very well.
